description: Defines the ServerSyncResponse class which processes and encapsulates server synchronization responses, including handling conflicts, errors, and payloads.

classes.name: ServerSyncResponse
classes.description: A class that models the server synchronization response, providing access to payloads, conflicts, errors, and response metadata.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ServerSyncResponse object, processing the raw response to extract payloads and conflicts.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns the error object if the response indicates an error.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: lastSyncToken
methods.description: Retrieves the last sync token from the response data.

methods.name: paginationToken
methods.description: Retrieves the pagination token from the response data.

methods.name: numberOfItemsInvolved
methods.description: Returns the total number of payloads involved in the sync response.
